title: Nourishing Ethiopian Gouda Tagine
description: A cultured and creamy Ethiopian dish featuring Gouda cheese, made vegan-friendly by using plant-based alternatives, and traditionally prepared in an earthenware bowl.

ingredients.name: Gouda cheese alternative
ingredients.notes: such as vegan Gouda or cashew cheese

instructions: Pound the onions, garlic, and ginger in a mortar and pestle until well combined.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the pounded onion mixture to the saucepan and cook until the onions are translucent.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Gouda cheese alternative to the saucepan and stir until melted and smooth.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the tagine to the earthenware bowl and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
